snippet.title: Wind-up Knight Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wind-up Knight is a high-end, action-packed, 3D side-scrolling adventure game for iOS and Android, and it's here to show you how games are supposed to be played.  

App Store link: http://itunes.apple.com/app/id482869428
Android Market link: https://market.android.com/details?id=com.robotinvader.knightmare

Guide your Wind-up Knight through devilish levels--over 50 in all--to rescue the Princess from the clutches of the evil Black Knight. Run, jump, roll, and slash your way to victory. Wind-up Knight is the type of challenging game you have been waiting for.

Developed by Robot Invader.  More info at http://robotinvader.com.
